page.title: Local Network
page.description_short: LAN addressing, DHCP, DMZ, IP passthrough and TTL.
page.description: LAN addressing, DHCP, DMZ, IP passthrough and TTL. Network changes take effect after a modem restart.

lan.description: Address of the modem on the local network.

dhcp.title: DHCP Server
dhcp.description: Addresses handed out to LAN clients.

passthrough.title: IP Passthrough
passthrough.description: Hands the mobile WAN address to one LAN device (bridge mode). The device must use DHCP.

dmz.description: Forwards every unsolicited inbound connection to one LAN host.

mobile.title: Mobile Connection
mobile.description: How the modem brings up the data connection.

ttl.title: TTL Override
ttl.description: Rewrites the IPv4 TTL of outgoing packets. Applied at once, no restart.

restart_dialog.title: Settings saved. Restart now?
restart_dialog.description: The new network settings take effect after a modem restart. LAN clients may need to renew their address afterwards.

errors.read_failed: Unable to read the network settings

validation.lan_ip_invalid: Enter a valid LAN IP address.
validation.lan_ip_reserved: The LAN IP cannot be the network or broadcast address of its subnet.
validation.lease_invalid: The lease time must be a positive number of seconds.
validation.dmz_invalid: Enter a valid DMZ host, other than the modem.
validation.dmz_subnet: The DMZ host must be in the LAN subnet.
validation.passthrough_mac: IP passthrough needs the client MAC (AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).
validation.dhcp_range_subnet: The DHCP range must be in the LAN subnet.
validation.dhcp_range_order: The DHCP range start must be lower than its end.
validation.dhcp_range_reserved: The DHCP range cannot include the network or broadcast address.
validation.dhcp_range_modem: The DHCP range cannot include the modem address.
